title: Requirement register — round 2 audit (2026-11-18)
rule: met requires an existing artifact path and an official source that supports the claim; otherwise partial with the reason stated.

statuses.met: implemented, cited artifact exists, official source supports it
statuses.partial: implemented but limited by a documented evidence gap (blank and flagged)
statuses.blocked: cannot be completed from official sources; blank and flagged

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.evidence: Store exists: nfl-book/data/price_snapshots.json holds 39 open/close pairs (13 Week-11 games x side/total/moneyline). Every market_open_value and market_close_value is null by policy (no official price source). The 'close' value is a model run trained on the 137 feed games, not a market close. Downgraded from met because the market half is blank.

rows.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.clears: the 13 missing official Week-10 finals added (transcribed with URLs on the Games page), and a line-by-line re-read of the 105 aggregate-only rows
rows.evidence: Round 2 reconciled the feed to the official standings: Weeks 1-9 (136 games) match 32 of 32 clubs on W, L, T, PF and PA (RC-11). The feed holds 1 of the 14 official Week-10 finals (RC-12). 105 of its 137 rows are aggregate-only, not re-read game by game. Downgraded from met until the 13 missing finals are added and the aggregate-only rows are re-read.
